description: Source code for managing PUCCH resources in a 3GPP NR (5G) RAN environment, including resource allocation, deallocation, and configuration updates for UEs within a cell.

classes.name: du_pucch_resource_manager
classes.description: Class responsible for managing PUCCH resource allocation, deallocation, and configuration within a 5G NR RAN node.

methods.name: add_cell
methods.description: Adds and initializes resource context for a new cell based on its configuration.

methods.name: rem_cell
methods.description: Removes a cell's resource context from the manager.

methods.name: alloc_resources
methods.description: Allocates PUCCH resources for a new UE, updating configurations accordingly.

methods.name: dealloc_resources
methods.description: Releases PUCCH resources associated with a UE, updating free resource lists.

methods.name: get_compatible_csi_cfg
methods.description: Finds a compatible CSI configuration that fits within payload and resource constraints.

methods.name: offset_exceeds_limit
methods.description: Checks if a given resource offset exceeds the maximum allowed grants per slot.

methods.name: compute_periodic_uci_slot_offsets
methods.description: Computes the set of slot offsets for SR and CSI resources based on their periodicities.

methods.name: sr_csi_offsets_collide
methods.description: Determines if SR and CSI resource offsets collide in time, using CRT logic.

methods.name: update_serv_cell_cfg
methods.description: Updates the serving cell configuration with allocated PUCCH resources and payload limits.

methods.name: disable_pucch_cfg
methods.description: Disables PUCCH configuration in the serving cell, releasing resources.
